name: SessionInfoPanel

component.name: SessionInfoPanel
component.description: Displays session details inline, beside an anchor element, or inside a container supplied by your application.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS class for the desktop panel.

props.name: style
props.description: Inline styles for the desktop panel.

props.name: anchor
props.description: Element to anchor the panel against on desktop. The panel is positioned next to it and kept on screen. Ignored when isMobile is true.

props.name: placement
props.description: Preferred side of the anchor; may flip to stay on screen. Only used with anchor.

props.name: isMobile
props.description: Renders only the panel content, without its own box or positioning, for a mobile sheet or another container supplied by your application. anchor and placement are ignored.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Shows a close button and is called when it is pressed. With anchor set, pressing Escape or clicking outside also calls it. The panel does not hide itself; set open to false in response. If you provide a mobile sheet, close it here. Without onClose, no close button is shown.

props.name: inviteLink
props.description: Invite URL supplied by your application. Shows a copyable link; omit or leave empty to hide it.

displayedFields.description: Session metadata is read automatically. Rows appear in this order. The invite link comes from the inviteLink prop and is hidden when empty.

fields.inviteLink: string (from the inviteLink prop; row hidden when empty)

notes: Displays the session topic, session ID, and your display name and user ID. The session password is not shown.
Supply inviteLink to show an invite link and its copy action. Session ID also supports copying.
Use SessionInfoButton for a managed trigger and popup, or SessionInfoPanel inside a custom surface.
With SessionInfoButton on desktop, the panel closes only when you click the button again or use the panel's close button.
